item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud las srung ba nyi zla'i gur khang
item.coloph: ces rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud las srung ba mi 'gyur nyi zla'i drwa gur 'di nyid/ bon sgo 'di la dad cing mos pa'i snying grogs sa trig sam sad kyis/ rin chen gnyis pa'i 'khor lo dang lhardzas dri med kyis 'tshams (mtshams) sbyar nas ring po'i dus nas bskur (bskul) ba dang*/ 'phral du bla chung g.yung drung bstan dbang gis lha rdzas kyi brda' sbyar/ yang slob grwa btsun g.yung drung phun tshogs kyi dri bral dar gar (dkar) gsang gos yug ring gis sna drangs te/ nye bar bskul ba la brten nas/ rig 'dzin nam mkha' sgron gsal gyi rjes 'bring tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ba'i ming ni g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa wa skyes seng lpags gyon pa'i rgyal khams kyi dkor zan sprang phal pa ci lta bu des/ dpa' bo chen po'i gsang lung dngos su thob bzhin lha mchog gang de sgrub pa'i thun mtshams su/ rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor mngon par shar ba'i nyin/ lcags bya zla ba 2tshes 3la dge bar bris pa'o//
